title: Brand
lede: The Pyreon mark, colours and type, and the few rules that keep them meaning something. Download the files, use them to talk about Pyreon, and keep the ember for the moment a signal changes.

sections.title: The mark
sections.text: The mark is the "-on" from the wordmark: a solid ember disc for the `o` (one lit particle) and a heavy bracket-stroke `n`. It is drawn on a 120 × 120 grid. Write the name "Pyreon", never "PyreonJS".

items.use: Primary mark. Ember disc, paper `n`. Dark backgrounds only: the `n` is paper-coloured and disappears on light.
One colour, paper (#F4EFE6). For dark backgrounds and single-colour print on dark.
One colour, ink (#14141C in the file). For paper and light backgrounds.
The colour mark on a rounded ink tile, sized 32 × 32. Browser tabs and app icons.

items.title: Clear space
items.text: Keep at least half the disc's radius free on every side: 11 units on the 120-unit grid, about 9% of the mark's width.

items.title: Minimum size
items.text: Colour mark: 32 px. One-colour mark: 16 px.

items.title: With the wordmark
items.text: Set "pyreon" in lower case, Space Grotesk 600, at 0.7 × the mark's height, with a gap of 0.22 × its height, on the baseline of the `n`.

items.title: Ember "on"
items.text: In a hero you may set "pyre" in ink or paper and give the trailing "on" the ember gradient. Once per page at most.

sections.title: Colour
sections.text: Two neutrals, one gradient, two cool accents. Ember marks signal propagation and active state; everything else stays quiet.

faces.name: Space Grotesk
faces.role: Headings, body and the wordmark. Headings from 22 px up get negative letter-spacing, tighter as they grow.

faces.name: JetBrains Mono
faces.role: Code, and the small upper-case eyebrow labels above sections.

sections.title: Motion
text: When a value changes, only the node that reads it moves: a 200 ms pulse from its resting colour to ember core and back, easing `cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .3, 1)`. Nothing else animates: no page transitions, hover effects or loaders in ember.
With reduced motion, the pulse becomes a static 2 px ember underline, so the meaning survives without the movement.

items.do: Use the colour mark on ink.
items.dont: Put the colour mark on paper; its `n` vanishes. Use the one-colour ink mark instead.

items.do: Scale the mark as a whole.
items.dont: Stretch, rotate, outline or re-colour the gradient.
items.why: The disc and the `n` are one letterform.

items.do: Keep ember for change and active state.
items.dont: Use ember as a full-bleed background, a default button fill or a decorative border.

items.do: "2.6× faster than React at 10,000 rows (synthetic, author-run)."
items.why: A number someone can check beats an adjective nobody can.

end.title: One lit particle. Use it where something changes.
